title: A PRAYER FOR
GOD'S FAVOR
end: The Family Altar — cover your home in prayer
stock_queries: warm golden hour light on a wooden kitchen table with an open bible
soft focus olive branch shadows on a white wall
peaceful country home exterior at twilight with glowing windows
close up of hands resting on an open vintage bible
gentle morning light streaming through a clean farmhouse window
a burning candle on a wooden table in a quiet room

scenes.a: If the uncertainty of your future feels heavy today, let this prayer settle your heart.
Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.
And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
Lord, breathe your purpose into our daily labors and guide every decision we make together.
May our family reflect your goodness in all that we do as we walk forward.
We entrust our home and our future into your steady and loving hands today, Amen.
